title: Vitalik outlines a narrower, longevity-focused direction for the Ethereum Foundation
summary: Vitalik Buterin described the Ethereum Foundation's evolving role as operating like 'one node' rather than the center of Ethereum. The EF holds only ~0.16% of all ETH and is choosing longevity over breadth: selling less ETH and narrowing focus to censorship-resistance, privacy, and security (CROPs), with technical priorities including AI-assisted formal verification and intermediary minimization (e.g. FOCIL, EIP-8141).
